title: Page 5
slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
content_zh:
周屹天不置可否。

太白楼当家听到赵小丫藉着昆阳侯府的名头要借灶房，二话不说让厨子让出一个灶口。

赵小丫手脚俐落的做了几道菜，让人端到楼上。

原本卫元召还真没将赵小丫的手艺当一回事，但当菜上桌，吃了一口之后便停不下筷。

周屹天嫌恶的看着卫元召，以前还当他斯文，原来也只是端个样子。

怕少吃了，他不发一言开始动作，下筷的速度一点都不输人。

赵小丫倒没吃多少，原以为自己煮多了，但看两人的模样，担心立刻放下。

“小丫，你这手艺果然比太白楼的厨子强。”

赵小丫的手艺是跟寡妇厨娘学的，她心知肚明，若真要论好，远远不及寡妇厨娘。

寡妇厨娘的祖上出过御厨，要不是命不好，家道中落，嫁的夫君早死，留下孤儿寡母，也不会沦落到太白楼讨生活。

“卫公子喜欢，等哥哥得空再来庄子做客。”

哥哥？这算哪门子的情趣？这个称呼令卫元召的嘴角抽了抽，他难掩鄙视的看着周屹天，竟要未过门的媳妇叫哥哥，这脸皮还真厚。

周屹天压根没理会卫元召的不以为然，他就是享受赵小丫软软的叫他哥哥，他们如今是彼此最重要也是唯一的亲人，至于其他人的感受——与他何干？

第十二章 想为他挣银子(2)

雪才化，赵小丫便闲不住，跟着庄子里的奴才给菜园子松土。

奴才从原本的惶恐到最后接受，然后赞叹——毕竟农村出身，赵小丫做来还比其他人俐落快速。

杏儿跟在赵小丫身后撒种子，眼中都冒着崇拜的光亮。

“姑娘，这世上还有什么是你不会的？”杏儿忍不住开口，“姑娘不单识字，针线做得好，烧的饭菜美味勾人，泡的茶好喝，现在连农活都是能手，简直是完美。”

赵小丫拿耙子的手一顿，转身对她一笑，“我哪有你说的这么好。”

一旁的夏嬷嬷听了笑道：“姑娘确实是好。”又道：“姑娘要动手，老奴管不了，但得注意天气多变，乍暖还寒，姑娘别在外头待得太久，免得受了寒气。”

夏嬷嬷对赵小丫初来乍到病得躺在床上好几日一事印象深刻，那阵子周屹天一张脸黑如锅底，下人们都提着心在干活儿。

赵小丫脾气好，但周屹天却不是个好说话的主，若让赵小丫有个不好，庄子上下的奴才皮就得绷紧了。

赵小丫明白夏嬷嬷心中的估计，便对她一笑，“我知道，我不会逞能的。”

夏嬷嬷看着赵小丫的笑脸，这才多久的时间，小姑娘长了点肉，白了不口一、两分，倒有些美人胚子的模样。

“嬷嬷。”手上的活儿没停，赵小丫随口问道：“前些日子你提过爷在城里有间糧行，可收益只能勉强打平，如今管事的姓张，也是顾家留下的老人？”

夏嬷嬷点了点头，“是啊，管事叫张丰，就一家四口人管着粮行。”她看了杏儿一眼，“杏儿订下的亲事就是张丰的大儿子张青。不是老奴替老张家说话，而是粮行收益不好跟张丰确实没太大关系。”

“姑娘也是个会过日子的，所以应该清楚，粮行下乡收粮总要现钱，但是爷向来不管这事儿，粮行没足够的现钱收粮，铺里能卖的粮食不多，生意自然不好。头几年张丰还会找机会向侯府二夫人讨，但二夫人总是三言两语打发，爷又不上心，久了张丰也就不再多说，就这么不上不下的耗着。”

赵小丫早从夏嬷嬷口中得知侯府水深，侯府中馈握在二房夫人的手里。

纵使学管家才没多久，但她知道要拿钱不容易，就算周屹天出面，吃穿用度绝对不敢苛刻，但若是扶植周屹天的私产，跟她讨要银两让粮行赚个金银满满，那是痴人说梦话。

她侧了下头，与其纠结二房行事，她在意的倒是周屹天的态度。

二房打压，他不可能看不明白，却总是听之任之……上辈子周屹天是个铁面无私的大将军，虽面如冠玉，却手段凶残，所以虽然不清楚二房后来的下场，但她知道曾经惹过他的人，结局总归不是好的。

如今周屹天该是处于虎落平阳之时……赵小丫用力的松土，脑袋飞快的转动，她不会让周屹天为了银钱向二房低头，只是不当家不知柴米贵，不过个把月她便看出庄子里几乎是自给自足，所以她得找个适合的营生。

只是她能找到什么样的营生？庄子的地不大，能种植的地不到五亩，留给庄子吃就已经差不多，也不用指望买卖，至于后院池子倒是可以等凉时养些鱼虾，但终归不是长久之法。

她顾着思索，没有留意到周遭蓦然一静，直到面前罩上了阴影，挡住了大半光亮，她才愣愣的抬起头。

看到周屹天，她旋即露出一抹笑。

周屹天伸出手将她拉起来，看着她的手满布泥土，不由得挑了下眉。

“你知道的，我本就没法子当个闲人，如今日子过得太舒坦，只在房内窝着，我怕人都懒了。”

赵小丫给杏儿使个眼色，经过这段时间的相处，主仆俩不单亲近了不少，还有了默契。

杏儿立刻备好水，上前让赵小丫净手。

周屹天松开她的手臂，看着她净手，等她拿着帕子擦手时，转身离去。

赵小丫见状匆匆交代杏儿一句，“热碗杏仁茶过来。”随即跟在周屹天身后进屋。

周岳已经叫人抬了热水进净室，赵小丫没有两话的挽起衣袖伺侯他洗漱。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

周屹天洗去今日在军营与将士近身搏斗的疲累，套上了干净的衣袍。

待他走出净室，杏儿小心翼翼的上了碗杏仁茶，原要退下，却多嘴了一句，“爷，这是姑娘特地给爷留的杏仁茶。爷虽然没来，但姑娘日日都挂心着。”

周屹天闻言只是淡淡的轻应了一声。

虽然依然面无表情，但杏儿能感觉周屹天的心情变好了些许，她暗暗的看了赵小丫一眼，就见赵小丫给了她赞赏的眼神。

杏儿俏皮一笑，主子心情好，奴才的心才能安。

“挺会收买人心的。”喝了口杏仁茶，周屹天没有放过她们方才的小眼神。

赵小丫坐到他身旁低头给他剥瓜子配茶喝，“我真的是日日挂心哥哥，难道你不信？”

周屹天的回答是轻捏了下她的脸。

赵小丫一笑，“幸好你是今日回来，明日我打算进城一趟，去看看粮行。我看了夏嬷嬷送来的帐本，粮行生意不太好。”

周屹天接过她递过来的瓜子，粮行是他娘的嫁妆之一，但他从来都没有放在心上，毕竟在他的眼中，不论是庄子或是粮行都是用来安置顾家的老人，他并不指望这些赚钱，他所图的可不是这么丁点银两。看出赵小丫有兴趣，他没多言，就由着她去。

“明天我去瞧瞧，若生意始终无起色……”赵小丫小心翼翼的看着他，“不如我们换个营生，你意下如何？”

周屹天不以为意，“你说好便成。”

赵小丫原以为得要费点唇舌，没料到周屹天连句话都没问就点头同意。

看她呆愣的样子，周屹天横了她一眼，“怎么？我点头了还不满意？”

满意！太满意了！她的双眼发光，脱口说道：“我打算开酒楼。”

周屹天闻言皱起了眉头，他虽知她的厨艺好，却没打算让她去当厨娘，霎时后悔自己答应得太快。
content_en:
Zhou Yitian was noncommittal.

When the head of Taibai Tower heard that Zhao Xiaoya wanted to borrow a kitchen in the name of Kunyang Houfu, he asked the cook to give up a kitchen without saying a word.

Zhao Xiaoya quickly cooked a few dishes and had them brought upstairs.

Originally, Wei Yuanzhao really didn't take Zhao Xiaoya's craftsmanship seriously, but when the food was served, he couldn't stop eating it after taking one bite.

Zhou Yitian looked at Wei Yuanzhao with disgust. He used to think he was polite, but it turned out he was just showing off.

Afraid of not eating enough, he started to move without saying a word, and his chopsticks were as fast as anyone else's.

Zhao Xiaoya didn't eat much. She thought she had cooked too much, but looking at the looks of the two of them, she immediately put her worries aside.

"Xiaoya, your skills are indeed better than those of the cooks in Taibai Building."

Zhao Xiaoya learned her skills from the widow cook, and she knew very well that if she really wanted to be good at it, she would be far inferior to the widow cook.

The widowed cook's ancestors had served as royal cooks. If she hadn't had bad luck, her family had fallen into disgrace, her husband had died early, leaving her orphaned and widowed, she wouldn't have been reduced to Taibai Tower to earn a living.

"Master Wei likes it. I will come to Zhuangzi as a guest when my brother is free."

Brother?What kind of fun is this?This title made Wei Yuanzhao's lips twitch. He couldn't hide his contempt and looked at Zhou Yitian for asking his unmarried daughter-in-law to call him brother. This was really shameless.

Zhou Yitian ignored Wei Yuanzhao's disapproval at all. He just enjoyed Zhao Xiaoya softly calling him brother. They were now each other's most important and only relatives. As for other people's feelings - what did it have to do with him?

Chapter 12 Want to make money for him (2)

The snow had just melted, and Zhao Xiaoya couldn't sit still. She followed the slaves in Zhuangzi to loosen the soil in the vegetable garden.

The slave went from initial fear to acceptance and admiration - after all, Zhao Xiaoya was born in a rural area and could do things more swiftly and quickly than others.

Myolie followed Zhao Xiaoya and spread the seeds, her eyes shining with admiration.

"Girl, what else in this world can you not do?" Xing'er couldn't help but say, "Girl is not only literate, but also good at needlework, the food she cooks is delicious, the tea she makes is delicious, and now she's even good at farm work. It's perfect."

Zhao Xiaoya paused with her hand holding the rake, turned around and smiled at her, "How can I be as good as you say?"

Aunt Xia, who was on the side, laughed and said, "The girl is indeed good." She added, "If the girl wants to do something, I can't control it, but I have to pay attention to the changeable weather, from warm to cold. Don't stay outside for too long, lest you catch the cold."

Aunt Xia was deeply impressed by the fact that Zhao Xiaoya was so sick that she lay in bed for several days when she first arrived. At that time, Zhou Yitian's face was as black as the bottom of a pot, and the servants were all working with their hearts on their minds.

Zhao Xiaoya has a good temper, but Zhou Yitian is not an easy talker. If Zhao Xiaoya does anything wrong, Zhuangzi's slave skin will be tightened.

Zhao Xiaoya understood what Nanny Xia was thinking and smiled at her, "I know, I won't show off."

Aunt Xia looked at Zhao Xiaoya's smiling face. In just a short time, the little girl had put on some flesh, turned a bit or two whiter, and looked a bit like a beauty.

"Mommy." Zhao Xiaoya asked casually without stopping the work on her hands: "A few days ago, you mentioned that I have a grain store in the city, but the income can only be barely equal. The person in charge now is named Zhang, and he is also an old man left by the Gu family?"

Aunt Xia nodded, "Yes, the steward's name is Zhang Feng, and there are four members of the family in charge of the grain store." She glanced at Xing'er, "Xing'er's marriage is to Zhang Feng's eldest son Zhang Qing. It's not that the old slave speaks for the old Zhang family, but the poor income of the grain store really has nothing to do with Zhang Feng."

"Girls are also good at living, so they should know that the grain store always needs cash when going to the countryside to collect grain, but I have never paid attention to this. The grain store does not have enough cash to collect grain, and there is not much grain to sell in the shop, so the business is naturally not good. In the first few years, Zhang Feng would find opportunities to ask the second lady of the Hou Mansion for begging, but the second lady always dismissed it with a few words, and I didn't care. After a long time, Zhang Feng stopped talking more, and just wasted it."

Zhao Xiaoya had already learned from Aunt Xia that the water in the Hou Mansion was deep, and that the royal palace was in the hands of the second wife.

Even though she had just studied housekeeping for a short time, she knew that it was not easy to get money. Even if Zhou Yitian came forward, she would never dare to be harsh on food and clothing. But if she wanted to support Zhou Yitian's private property and asked her for some silver so that the grain bank could make a lot of gold and silver, that would be nonsense.

She tilted her head. Instead of worrying about her second wife's behavior, what she cared about was Zhou Yitian's attitude.

It was impossible for him not to understand the oppression of the second room, but he always let it go... In his previous life, Zhou Yitian was a selfless general. Although he had a handsome appearance, his methods were cruel. So although she didn't know what happened to the second room later, she knew that the ending of those who had offended him was not always good.

Now Zhou Yitian should be at the moment when the tiger is dead... Zhao Xiaoya loosened the soil hard and turned her head quickly. She would not let Zhou Yitian bow to the second house for money. It was just that a family member did not know how expensive firewood and rice were. Within a few months, she could see that the village was almost self-sufficient, so she had to find a suitable livelihood.

But what kind of livelihood can she find?Zhuangzi's land is not big, with less than five acres of land that can be planted. It is enough for Zhuangzi to eat, and there is no need to expect business. As for the backyard pond, you can raise some fish and shrimp when it cools down, but it is not a long-term solution.

She was so busy thinking that she didn't notice the sudden silence around her. It wasn't until a shadow fell in front of her, blocking most of the light, that she raised her head blankly.

Seeing Zhou Yitian, she immediately smiled.

Zhou Yitian stretched out his hand to pull her up. Seeing that her hands were covered with dirt, he couldn't help but raise his eyebrows.

"You know, I can't afford to be an idler. Now my life is too comfortable. I just stay in my room. I'm afraid that everyone will be lazy."

Zhao Xiaoya winked at Xing'er. After this period of getting along, the master and servant not only got closer, but also had a tacit understanding.

Xing'er immediately prepared water and stepped forward to ask Zhao Xiaoya to clean her hands.

Zhou Yitian let go of her arm and watched her clean her hands. When she wiped her hands with the handkerchief, she turned and left.

Seeing this, Zhao Xiaoya hurriedly told Xing'er, "Come over with a hot bowl of almond tea." Then she followed Zhou Yitian into the house.

Zhou Yue had already asked someone to bring hot water into the clean room. Zhao Xiaoya rolled up her sleeves and waited for him to wash up without a word.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

Zhou Yitian washed away the fatigue from today's close combat with the soldiers in the military camp and put on clean clothes.

After he walked out of the clean room, Xing'er carefully served a bowl of almond tea. She was about to leave, but she said something more, "Master, this is the almond tea that the girl left specially for me. Although I didn't come, the girl is worried about him every day."

Zhou Yitian just responded lightly when he heard the words.

Although her face was still expressionless, Myolie could feel that Zhou Yitian's mood had improved a little. She glanced at Zhao Xiaoya secretly, and saw Zhao Xiaoya giving her a look of appreciation.

Xing'er smiled playfully. Only when the master is in a good mood can the slave's heart be at ease.

"He's quite good at winning people's hearts." After taking a sip of almond tea, Zhou Yitian didn't let go of their little glances just now.

Zhao Xiaoya sat next to him and lowered her head to peel melon seeds and drink them with tea, "I really care about my brother every day, don't you believe it?"

Zhou Yitian's answer was to pinch her face lightly.

Zhao Xiaoya smiled and said, "Fortunately you came back today. Tomorrow I plan to go to the city to visit the grain store. I saw the account book sent by Grandma Xia and the business of the grain store is not very good."

Zhou Yitian took the melon seeds she handed over. The grain store was one of his mother's dowries, but he never took it seriously. After all, in his eyes, both Zhuangzi and the grain store were used to house the elderly people of the Gu family. He did not expect these to make money. What he wanted was not such a small amount of money.Seeing that Zhao Xiaoya was interested, he let her go without saying anything.

"I'll go take a look tomorrow. If the business never improves..." Zhao Xiaoya looked at him cautiously, "Why don't we change our business? What do you think?"

Zhou Yitian didn't take it seriously, "It will be done as you say."

Zhao Xiaoya originally thought that she would have to work hard, but she didn't expect that Zhou Yitian nodded in agreement without even asking a question.

Seeing her stunned look, Zhou Yitian glanced at her, "What? I nodded and you're not satisfied?"

Satisfied!So satisfied!Her eyes were shining and she blurted out: "I plan to open a restaurant."

Zhou Yitian frowned when he heard this. Although he knew that she was good at cooking, he had no intention of letting her become a cook. He instantly regretted that he had agreed too quickly.
